officers.name: Deputy Sheriff Parker Perry
officers.story: Deputy Sheriff Parker Perry succumbed to gunshot wounds he received while responding to a domestic violence call on November 3, 2026. Around 2:25 p.m., deputies responded to a female victim stating she had been shot at the 18700 block of South Smythe Road in Spangle.

officers.name: Deputy Sheriff Ryan Terpsma
officers.story: Deputy Sheriff Ryan Terpsma was shot and killed while responding to a disturbance call at 119 Lone Pine Trail in Eureka. Around 8:23 p.m., Deputy Terpsma and a Eureka police officer arrived at the home and were fired upon by a man inside the home.

officers.name: Deputy Sheriff Caden Ryan Mullins
officers.story: Deputy Sheriff Caden Mullins was killed when his cruiser was struck by a coal truck at the intersection of West Virginia Route 10 and Rum Creek Road at approximately 4:30 PM.

officers.name: Detective Jeffrey Lee Smith
officers.story: Detective Jeffrey Smith suffered a fatal heart attack while engaged in a foot pursuit on Highway 19 near Rocky Top Road in Cherokee, North Carolina. Detective Smith and another officer pulled a struggling suspect from the Oconaluftee River and up the riverbed when Detective Smith collapsed.

officers.name: Deputy Sheriff Adam Sherifi
officers.agency: Van Zandt County Sheriff's Office | TX
officers.story: Deputy Sheriff Adam Sherifi was shot and killed while serving a felony warrant at the 4300 block of State Highway 198 in Van Zandt County. Deputy Sherifi was assisting Canton police officers serving outstanding warrants for aggravated assault and aggravated assault on a peace officer.

officers.name: Sergeant Jacob Roesler
officers.story: Sergeant Jacob Roesler was killed in a vehicle crash on State Routes 51 and 795. Around 6:30 a.m., Sergeant Roesler was responding to a separate collision when his patrol vehicle collided with another vehicle.

officers.name: Deputy Sheriff Katherine Frank
officers.story: Deputy Sheriff Katherine Frank succumbed to injuries resulting from a shooting near the 2900 block of South Keyrell Drive in Sioux Falls, three days prior.

officers.name: Homicide Agent Kevin Morris
officers.story: Homicide Agent Kevin Morris was killed when a wrong-way driver crashed into his vehicle on Interstate 95 south of State Road 46 in Titusville.

officers.name: Sergeant Shane Seiber
officers.story: Sergeant Shane Seiber was shot and killed while responding to a disturbance call in West Philadelphia, near the 100 block of North 52nd Street at approximately 1:00 am.

officers.name: Trooper Bradley Ritger
officers.story: Trooper Brad Ritger succumbed to injuries sustained on September 21, 2026, when he fell from a highway overpass on I-94 in Dunn County after deploying spike strips.
